decisions.reason: Keeping a temporary utility bridge available for a specified period does not require buying a new bridge.
The position covers erecting and dismantling a temporary weather shelter, not purchasing a new shelter.
The position charges for keeping a temporary weather shelter available over time.
The position covers assembling and removing a temporary timber footbridge, with no new supply specified.
The position charges for keeping temporary timber footbridges available over time.
The position covers relocating a temporary footbridge, not supplying a new one.
The position covers setting up and clearing a temporary trench crossing using precast slabs; it does not require purchasing new slabs.
The position charges for keeping temporary trench crossings available over time.
The position covers relocating a temporary trench crossing, with no new supply specified.
The position covers erecting and removing temporary site fencing, not purchasing new fencing.
The position covers relocating temporary site fencing, with no new supply specified.
The position charges for keeping temporary site fencing in place over time.
The position covers setting up and taking down warning lights, with no new lights specified for purchase.
The position covers relocating warning lights, not supplying new ones.
The position charges for keeping warning lights available over time.
The position covers setting up and taking down traffic signs, with no new supply specified.
The position charges for keeping traffic signs available over time.
The position covers setting up and taking down directional signs, with no new supply specified.
The position charges for keeping directional signs available over time.
The position covers setting up and taking down supplementary signs, with no new supply specified.
The position charges for keeping supplementary signs available over time.
The deliverable is photographic documentation; the CDs are only delivery media.
The position delivers additional copies of photographic documentation on CD, not a separately purchased physical product.
The deliverable is photographic documentation; the binders serve only to present it.
The position covers surveying and preparing as-built documentation; the CDs are only delivery media.
The deliverable is an additional copy of the as-built documentation on CD.
